title: CoopEval: Benchmarking Cooperation-Sustaining Mechanisms and LLM Agents in Social Dilemmas
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLM agents on social dilemmas which are standard frameworks for evaluating moral and ethical decision-making. It explicitly analyzes reasoning through ethical lenses such as 'social welfare maximization' (utilitarianism) and 'inequity aversion,' and contrasts its mechanisms with prior 'moral decision making' finetuning methods.
